metadata.title: PouriaX - Full-Stack Developer & Creative Technologist

about.title: About
about.mainText: Hey, I'm Pouria. I've been working with different tools and technologies for a few years, but lately my main focus has been web development. For about a year and a half, I've been working with Next.js, during which I've built several projects and worked on applications with relatively scalable structures. My main focus has been on the front-end, though I have some familiarity with back-end concepts as well. I also work with TypeScript and always try to keep learning new things and improving my skills.
about.overlayText: I've always been drawn to things that allow me to create — sometimes with guitar, sometimes through design, and often through code. Whether I'm sketching an idea on paper or implementing it in the browser, it gives me the same feeling: building something from nothing. That feeling is what keeps me motivated to keep going.

evolearn.name: Evolearn Frontend
evolearn.description: A modern e‑learning platform for programming education.
evolearn.moreDesc:
• Developed a scalable frontend architecture for a full‑featured e‑learning platform using Next.js.
• Built dynamic course interfaces supporting modular lessons and structured learning paths.
• Implemented responsive landing pages optimized for performance and accessibility.
• Integrated admin and user panels for content management and course publishing.
• Applied technical SEO including semantic HTML structure and metadata optimization.
• Built reusable UI components using Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui.

dashboard.name: E‑Commerce Admin Dashboard
dashboard.description: A complex admin dashboard for managing an online shopping platform.
dashboard.moreDesc:
• Developed a feature‑rich admin dashboard for managing products, categories, and store data.
• Implemented complex relational interfaces including product tags and nested database relations.
• Built advanced data tables supporting editing, filtering, and relational management.
• Designed scalable UI components capable of handling large datasets.
• Focused on modular architecture and maintainable component structure.

carlift.name: Car Lifting Service Website
carlift.description: A business website designed to generate leads for a roadside assistance company.
carlift.moreDesc:
• Designed and developed a modern website for a vehicle lifting and roadside assistance service.
• Built a responsive SPA‑style landing page focused on conversion and service clarity.
• Implemented technical SEO including semantic structure and metadata optimization.
• Developed a management panel for updating service content.
• Optimized UX and performance to improve customer acquisition.

faceai.name: AI Face Detection & Recognition
faceai.description: A browser‑based application for real‑time face detection using AI.
faceai.moreDesc:
• Built a real‑time face detection and recognition system using JavaScript and AI models.
• Implemented browser‑based computer vision for detecting faces in images and video streams.
• Developed an interactive UI for capturing and analyzing facial data.
• Integrated machine learning models capable of identifying human faces.
• Optimized processing performance for real‑time browser execution.
